Question B-002-009-008.

Why the correct answer is right: An azimuthal world map centred on your station is most useful for showing the bearing from you to any location.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "To allow computing the radiation angle to any location": Radiation angle is an antenna and propagation matter, not what this map primarily computes.
- sourceIndex 2: "To associate distances with optimal ionospheric region": Ionospheric-region selection depends on propagation analysis, while the centred map supplies direction from the centre point.
- sourceIndex 3: "To show the azimuth to meteor showers throughout the year": Meteor-shower work is specialized; the map's general use is bearing from the chosen centre.
